q: How Do I Start Using The Space?
a: Drop in during any open hours, and all that's needed is to fill out a safety waiver.

q: How Much Will a Membership Cost?
a: The current price of a monthly membership is $75, but this is subject to change. All other one-time usage and rental fees have yet to be determined.

q: Can I Bring My Own Tools and Materials?
a: Yes, as long as they fit within our safety rules and regulations and you have been given authorization to use them.

q: How Can I Be Authorized To Use Tools and Materials?
a: Through passing our safety assessment for specific items.

q: What Types of Projects Can I Work On?
a: Anything that has a designated area in our space. If there is something we missed, please let us know and we will try to accommodate it.
